name: app-home
title: App home
description: The front page of an app (a module's Lenses): key counts such as approved and waiting, what needs the person looking at it, and a tile for each page — all from the data and TM1 security.

settings.heading: The app's name
settings.subtitle: One line under it
settings.note: A short note from the app owner, e.g. a deadline (optional)
settings.counts: [{ label, mdx, tone: good | warn | bad, open }] — counts shown as tiles; the count is how many rows the MDX returns (use NON EMPTY / FILTER); open: a Lens to open on click
settings.needsMe: [{ label, mdx, groups, open }] — shown only to people in groups, and only when the count is above 0; '{n}' in the label is replaced by the count
settings.pages: [{ lens, title, description, groups }] — a tile per Lens in the app; groups limits who sees it

example.heading: Capex
example.subtitle: Capital expenditure requests and approvals
example.note: Requests for next year close on 15 November.

counts.label: requests
counts.mdx: SELECT {[Capital].[Capital].[Purchase Cost]} ON 0, NON EMPTY {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([organization].[organization])},0)} * {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([CapitalList].[CapitalList])},0)} * {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([Asset Types].[Asset Types])},0)} ON 1 FROM [Capital] WHERE ([Year].[Year].[Y2],[Version].[Version].[Target])

counts.label: approved
counts.mdx: SELECT {[Capital].[Capital].[Purchase Cost]} ON 0, NON EMPTY FILTER({TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([organization].[organization])},0)} * {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([CapitalList].[CapitalList])},0)} * {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([Asset Types].[Asset Types])},0)}, [Capital].[Capital].[Approved] = "Y") ON 1 FROM [Capital] WHERE ([Year].[Year].[Y2],[Version].[Version].[Target])

counts.label: waiting for approval
counts.mdx: SELECT {[Capital].[Capital].[Purchase Cost]} ON 0, NON EMPTY FILTER({TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([organization].[organization])},0)} * {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([CapitalList].[CapitalList])},0)} * {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([Asset Types].[Asset Types])},0)}, [Capital].[Capital].[Approved] <> "Y") ON 1 FROM [Capital] WHERE ([Year].[Year].[Y2],[Version].[Version].[Target])

needsMe.label: {n} requests waiting for your approval
needsMe.mdx: SELECT {[Capital].[Capital].[Purchase Cost]} ON 0, NON EMPTY FILTER({TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([organization].[organization])},0)} * {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([CapitalList].[CapitalList])},0)} * {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([Asset Types].[Asset Types])},0)}, [Capital].[Capital].[Approved] <> "Y") ON 1 FROM [Capital] WHERE ([Year].[Year].[Y2],[Version].[Version].[Target])
